mechanism: Cefazolin contains a methylthiotetrazole side chain that can cause disulfiram-like reactions (flushing, nausea, hypotension) when combined with disulfiram due to inhibition of aldehyde dehydrogenase and accumulation of acetaldehyde.
action: Monitor for disulfiram-like reaction symptoms; consider alternative cephalosporin without methylthiotetrazole side chain (e.g., ceftriaxone) or alternative antibiotic class if disulfiram cannot be discontinued.
